 Woman looks bored at Harry Styles gig and then people realise who she really is
 A woman was recently spotted appearing to look bored at a Harry Styles gig, as she was filmed sitting in the crowd. However, it wasn't long before people started to realise who she was
 Add to preferred sources Comments Lifestyle Katie-Ann Gupwell Content Editor 11:21, 23 Oct 2026 Updated 11:21, 23 Oct 2026 View Image She was spotted at a Harry Styles gig (stock image) (Image: AFP via Getty Images) 
 A woman was recently spotted appearing to look rather bored at a concert and then people realised who she was. A video of the moment has recently emerged, with many clips having gone viral , after she was seen sitting down at a Harry Styles gig.
 ‌ 
 ‌ 
 It comes as Harry has been on the road for his Together, Together Tour, as the star has been putting on impressive shows around the world . However, in one US venue, it's fair to say people didn't expect to see a particular attendee sitting in the crowd as Harry performed some of his greatest hits.
 ‌ 
 This isn't the first time a famous face has been spotted at a concert either. Previously, someone else floored Jay-Z fans when she was seen dancing at his London gig. 
 ‌ 
 A clip of the moment was shared alongside the caption: "Anna Wintour attended #TogetherTogetherNYC Night 25 - 21 October (via familyshowstyle)." The post quickly got people talking.
 In the footage, you can see Anna sat down wearing sunglasses as fans stood up around her. Her expression was rather neutral as other people bobbed along to the music nearby.

 One person couldn't help but draw attention to her expression, writing: "I’m sure she’s having fun on the inside!" Another added: "You are kidding! It is the hottest show in town though!"
 ‌ 
 A third replied: "She and Harry sat next to each other at London Fashion Week a couple years ago. I think it’s nice she attended his concert."
 Meanwhile, a fourth commented: "It may not look like it, but she is having a great time. I bet this means she and Harry will be working together on something soon."
 ‌ 
 One more also responded: "Very Anna Wintour of her." The post triggered a lot of conversation, with many claiming it's iconic that she went to the show.
 Even though some pointed out she looked a little "miserable", others thought she was having a great time. Many were just floored that she was there.
 ‌ 
 About Anna
 Dame Anna Wintour, 76, is a British-American media executive who served as editor-in-chief of Vogue from 1988 to 2025. At the moment, she serves as global chief content officer and artistic director at Condé Nast.
 She is often recognised for her pageboy bob haircut and dark sunglasses. For those who don't know of her, she is actually considered one of the most powerful women in publishing.
 Article continues below She has evolved into a very important figure in the fashion world. In fact, Anna has served as the lead chairperson of the annual haute couture Met Gala global fashion spectacle in Manhattan since the 1990s.
 Anna is highly regarded for her ability to identify emerging fashion trends. She is a well-known name all over the world.
